title: Insurance Claim Services Write-Off Authority and Appraisal Referral Limits
content:
| Arrangement | Program price write-off allowed | Denied line billable to customer | Appraisal referral threshold (USD) | Desk write-off cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | yes | 2500.00 | 500.00 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | no | yes | 2500.00 | 500.00 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | no | no | 2500.00 | 750.00 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | yes | no | 1000.00 | 750.00 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | no | yes | 2500.00 | 500.00 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | no | yes | 10000.00 | 1500.00 |

These are the controller's authority limits for Insurance Claim Services files.

- **Program price write-off allowed** — whether carrier program price adjustments are written off rather than billed to the insured, boolean.
- **Denied line billable to customer** — whether a line the carrier declines may be billed to the customer, boolean.
- **Appraisal referral threshold** — remaining disputed amount at or above which a scope dispute is referred to a human claims manager for appraisal, USD.
- **Desk write-off cap** — largest single carrier-denied-line write-off the desk may post, USD.

## Boundaries

- The cap is a ceiling the desk may reach: on Direction to Pay Claim Billing a single carrier-denied-line write-off of 500.00 USD is within the cap and one of 500.01 USD is above it.
- The referral threshold is inclusive: on Carrier Program Claim Billing a remaining dispute of 1000.00 USD is at the threshold, while 999.99 USD is below it.
- Only Carrier Program Claim Billing writes off program price adjustments; Assignment of Benefits and Carrier Program files never bill a denied line to the customer.
